changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 improved reaction description, added RHEA crossref, specified Fe, Heme as cofactors.

reactions.description: Epoxidation in intermediate meroterpenoid in the ascochlorin/ascofuranone biosynthetic pathway.
Converts Ilicicolin A to Ilicicolin A epoxide by stereoselective epoxidation of the terminal double bond of the prenyl group.
